Q00269_InventionAmbition/32486-07.html.text: Inventor Maru: You want to quit? I am sorry to hear you say that. Inventing is my life's passion, but I suppose you may have something else you need to attend to. Goodbye and good luck!

Q00269_InventionAmbition/32486-08.html.text: Inventor Maru: Thanks to you, I think I'll be able to complete my invention quickly now. I'm still relying on you! Keep up the good work.
